full_details: At eleven you rehearsed The Comedy of Errors with Phillips, Cowley and Pope. The hat was on the wrong peg. Cowley walked twelve paces from the property-chest and came in on Phillips's "anon." At two you played it. The plot on the post named you as a player and named no author. After the play the sharers met with the almanac open on the chest. Easter term ended today. Heminges took the comedy for Monday the ninth. He asked for a Labour's Won at Michaelmas, with the same four and the weddings. You said you have a king, and that he is about to be unkinged. Burbage set that for Michaelmas, when the Inns are back. Bryan asked whether a king put down will pass the Master. You said it is in the chronicle. Kemp asked what part he has. You said the parts are not cast. They agreed that some of the summer's takings may be kept back if playing thins, and they named no sum. Trinity term opens on the twentieth, eighteen days off. At home you left the parliament sheet blank.
one_sentence: You rehearsed Errors, played it at two, and afterwards the sharers took the comedy for Whit Monday and heard that your king is about to be unkinged.
title: The comedy for the ninth, and a king to be unkinged
